recipes.title: Equator Coffees — AeroPress
recipes.description: Equator Coffees' AeroPress guide for one small 6 oz cup of strong coffee: 18 g at 1:11, a sealed bloom, then a stir and a slow plunge at two minutes.

steps.instruction: place the AeroPress filter in the base and lock it onto the brewer
rinse the brewer with hot water to wet the filter and remove any paper taste; discard this water before moving forward
grind 18 g of coffee on a medium-fine setting and pour it into the brewer; place the brewer on a cup or carafe, set both on a scale and tare to 0

start the timer and pour 50 g of hot water quickly into the AeroPress to start the bloom; place the plunger into the AeroPress just enough to seal the top so the coffee does not drip out of the bottom
at 0:30–0:45, remove the plunger and quickly pour the remaining 150 g of water, then place the plunger back in the top to prevent dripping; the coffee continues to brew inside the AeroPress
remove everything from the scale, remove the plunger and give everything a five-second stir
push the plunger down slowly, aiming for 30 seconds, until you hear a hissing sound

recipes.notes: Equator call for an AeroPress filter, rinsed in the brewer with hot water and the rinse water discarded. The guide writes its water temperature as "just off boil at 205°" without naming a scale; Fahrenheit is the only reading the value admits. The second pour's cue is stated as a 0:30–0:45 window rather than a point, so that step carries no time. The brew is deliberately strong — Equator expect it to be diluted with hot water or milk to taste.
